Name: Pierre Price Randomizer
Author: Darkskyid
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Randomizes Pierre's shop prices every season with configurable multipliers. Optional JojaMart support included.
[line]
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b].[/*]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Seasonal Rerolls - [/b]Prices shuffle once per season[/*]
[*][b]Min/Max Multipliers - [/b]Set any range from 0.1x to 10.0x (default: 0.5x–2.0x)[/*]
[*][b]Spring Y1 Gate - [/b]Prices stay vanilla during your first Spring; toggleable[/*]
[*][b]Mail Notification - [/b]Pierre sends a letter when prices change each season[/*]
[*][b]Seeds Only Mode - [/b]Randomize only seeds; leave other items at vanilla prices[/*]
[*][b]JojaMart Support - [/b]Optional linked randomization with configurable discount[/*]
[*][b]Non-Destructive - [/b]Removing the mod reverts all prices to vanilla instantly (still, backup before you uninstall this mod)[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/b][/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*]Works with mods that add new items to Pierre's or JojaMart, those prices will be randomized too.[/*]
[*]Will conflict with mods that change how shop prices are calculated.[/*]
[/list]
